messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] notify-broker paging failure (alert_id=GH-9123) — attempted to deliver page to oncall but received 502 from pagerflow. service=notify-gateway env=prod

maria: Heads up — I didn't get a phone page. Slack mention only. @oncall-sre can you confirm?

josh: same here, I got the slack thread but no SMS/call. checking PagerFlow console now.

oncall-sre: I'm the current oncall, got the slack ping at 02:17 but no phone. PagerFlow shows 502 responses on outbound requests to carrier. Looking into upstream.

sam: PagerFlow logs show `upstream response code=502` from notify-gateway when fanout to pagerflow occurs. Reproducer:```bash
curl -v -H 'X-Service: notify-gateway' https://pagerflow.redwood.internal/v1/send 
# returns 502 with body: {"error":"upstream error"}```

sam: Opening runbook: https://confluence.redwood/infrarunbooks/pagerflow-502 and paging eng-infra. Manual escalation via ops_pager will be needed until we fix integration.

josh: Manual workaround: I ran `/ops_pager escalate primary -m "manual escalate GH-9123"` and primary got a phone page. Primary acknowledged :thumbsup:

eng-infra-bot: [deploy] notify-gateway v2.7.3 -> v2.8.0 deployed at 02:18. Rolling back to v2.7.3 due to 502 regressions. Commit: a1b2c3d

maria: Confirmed rollback triggered. Early signs show successful 200s from pagerflow. Continuing to monitor for 15m.

oncall-sre: Phone pages now coming through. I got an SMS and a call at 02:21. Marking paging restored.

josh: Postmortem note: integration lacked graceful retry for 502 from pagerflow; new rate-limiting header handling in v2.8.0 caused immediate failures on fanout. Will add circuit-breaker and backoff in notify-gateway.

incident-bot: Incident GH-9123 status: mitigated — paging restored. Keeping incident open for verification window (30m).
